content.text: All renewal terms are located in §§ 8.1–8.3; no other renewal or uplift language exists in the document.

input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: The renewal bargain meets the preferred position in full. § 8.2 provides automatic renewal in successive twelve-month periods (no multi-year evergreen), a Customer opt-out on thirty days' written notice (within the 30-day preferred limit), and a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal, with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is not sent. § 8.3 caps renewal increases to recurring Fees at the lesser of US CPI-U over the preceding twelve months and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. Because every conditional automatic-renewal element is satisfied, mutual written agreement is not required. No redline is warranted.

mappings.element: Renewal requires mutual written agreement unless every conditional automatic-renewal element below is met.
